description: Semantic group of toolbar controls. On the bar it is the layout wrapper TmToolbar's measurement flattens (data-tm-toolbar-group): its buttons take room individually and still collapse on their own. In the More menu of a TmToolbar Overflow=Menu the collapsed members keep the group as a labelled section (role=group with a visible, aria-hidden header), and runs of the same group are separated by role=separator.

parameters.name: Label
parameters.description: Accessible name of the group on the bar and the header of its section in the "More" menu. Empty renders the wrapper without a role — a layout-only group.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the group element.

examples.title: Labelled group whose collapsed members keep the group in More
examples.code:
<TmToolbar Overflow="ToolbarOverflow.Menu" AriaLabel="Diagram tools">
    <TmToolbarGroup Label="Edit">
        <TmToolbarButton Icon="@IconNames.Undo" Text="Undo" />
        <TmToolbarButton Icon="@IconNames.Redo" Text="Redo" Priority="ToolbarButtonPriority.Secondary" />
    </TmToolbarGroup>
    <TmToolbarDivider />
    <TmToolbarButton Icon="@IconNames.Save" Text="Save" Priority="ToolbarButtonPriority.Pinned" />
</TmToolbar>

examples.title: Layout-only group (no accessible name, no role)
examples.code:
<TmToolbar Overflow="ToolbarOverflow.Menu">
    <TmToolbarGroup Class="my-cluster">
        <TmToolbarButton Icon="@IconNames.Bold" Tooltip="Bold" />
        <TmToolbarButton Icon="@IconNames.Italic" Tooltip="Italic" />
    </TmToolbarGroup>
</TmToolbar>
